articles.title: Blockchain.com targets $500 million IPO this year at up to $6 billion valuation
articles.snippet: The London-based crypto services company confidentially filed for an initial public offering with the Securities and Exchange Commission earlier this year.

articles.title: Crypto PAC spends $11M to oppose Sherrod Brown in Ohio
articles.snippet: Fairshake pledged an initial $30 million on media opposing the Democratic candidate in Ohio’s Senate race in what some see as a repeat of spending by the crypto industry in 2024.

articles.title: Anthropic Lost $42 Billion Last Year. It Wants to Go Public at $2 Trillion
articles.snippet: The company's IPO prospectus shows revenue up twelvefold, a $518 billion spending plan, and a risk section warning that its own AI could pose existential risks to humanity.
